customer_text: My iPhone is stuck on the update screen and won't boot up.
brand_response: We're sorry to hear this. Try force-restarting: hold Side + Volume Down until the Apple logo appears. DM us if it persists.

customer_text: iOS 17 update keeps failing with error -1.
brand_response: Please try updating via iTunes/Finder on a Mac. If error continues, DM your device model and iOS version.

customer_text: Software update downloaded but won't install.
brand_response: Ensure you have at least 5 GB free storage and your battery is above 50%. Let us know if the issue continues.

customer_text: My phone restarted during update and now shows a black screen.
brand_response: This can happen due to interrupted updates. Force restart your device. If still unresponsive, visit an Apple Store.

customer_text: My iPhone battery drains super fast since the last update.
brand_response: Background app refresh can drain battery. Go to Settings > Battery to see which apps use the most power.

customer_text: My MacBook Pro fan runs constantly and gets very hot.
brand_response: Excessive heat can indicate high CPU usage. Open Activity Monitor to identify the responsible process.

customer_text: Touchscreen not responding in some areas of my iPad.
brand_response: Please clean the screen and remove any accessories. If the issue persists this may be a hardware issue—visit an Apple Store.

customer_text: My iPhone won't connect to Wi-Fi after the latest iOS update.
brand_response: Try forgetting the network and reconnecting: Settings > Wi-Fi > (i) > Forget This Network, then reconnect.

customer_text: Bluetooth keeps disconnecting from my AirPods.
brand_response: Reset your AirPods by holding the case button for 15 seconds. Then re-pair them in Settings > Bluetooth.

customer_text: My iCloud photos are not syncing across devices.
brand_response: Make sure iCloud Photos is on for all devices: Settings > [your name] > iCloud > Photos. Check your iCloud storage.

customer_text: App Store keeps saying my payment was declined.
brand_response: Please update your payment information in Settings > [your name] > Payment & Shipping. DM if issue continues.

customer_text: I was charged twice for Apple Music subscription.
brand_response: We're sorry about the double charge. Please DM us your Apple ID email so we can investigate this with our billing team.

customer_text: I forgot my Apple ID password and can't reset it.
brand_response: You can reset at iforgot.apple.com. If you still can't access it, DM us and we will guide you through account recovery.

customer_text: My account got locked after too many failed attempts.
brand_response: Your account is temporarily locked for security. Wait 24 hours or visit iforgot.apple.com to unlock it now.

customer_text: My iPhone screen cracked and I need a replacement.
brand_response: We can help with screen repairs! Visit apple.com/support/repair or schedule a Genius Bar appointment.

customer_text: I returned my MacBook 10 days ago but still haven't got my refund.
brand_response: We apologize for the delay. Please DM your order number and we will escalate your refund request immediately.

customer_text: What are your store hours?
brand_response: Store hours vary by location. Find your nearest Apple Store and its hours at apple.com/retail.

customer_text: Can I trade in my old iPhone for a new one?
brand_response: Yes! Visit apple.com/trade-in to see your trade-in value and start the process.

customer_text: Do you offer student discounts?
brand_response: Yes, Apple offers education pricing. Visit apple.com/education-discount or visit a store with your student ID.

customer_text: How do I contact Apple support by phone?
brand_response: You can reach Apple Support at 1-800-275-2273 or chat with us at getsupport.apple.com.
